title: حيازة المصادر
rule:
Applies when: When importing or merging material.
Preserve source identity and traceability; classify superseded, historical and unverifiable claims without inheriting prior approval assertions.
rationale: فقد المصدر أو وراثة موافقته دون تحقق يضعف سلسلة الحيازة. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
